items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: he plays uh with the same ease and technique uh that uh that Al plays down here pier 600 uh uh Al Hurt Al Hurt yeah he he he plays uh a technical style like that only he doesn't play with the the volume and the command that uh that Al plays with

ctx.x: quite a few of them let's back up a minute they must have had some piano players and some banjo players around

uh well uh just like I say uh our piano players boiled on down uh I told you by George Bouchon uh uh and um gee you caught me off guard here I have to stop and think for a minute um well Jack Sharp was real popular down there Jack was a sort of a character and he was uh one of the first people that I knew that became chord conscious in other words he he was he was exploring the possibilities of using different harmonies other than the straight major minor augmented and uh occasionally a diminished and a seventh…
